observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: television dance talent show stage with judges seated at a desk and bright purple/gold background lighting
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer on a large stage moving across the floor space
observation.posture: upright torso with flexible knees, bouncing and shifting weight in energetic rhythm
observation.footwork: fast steps, heel-toe weight shifts, kicking and sliding on the upbeat
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive arm movements, pointing, gesturing, and hand poses in coordination with footwork
observation.hips_and_torso: bouncing torso, quick turns, and drops with subtle hip movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent level changes including crouches, floor drops, and spins
observation.costume_and_props: colorful patterned short-sleeve button-down shirt, white shorts, sneakers, hair styled in braids
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and fast weight transfers are partially obscured by camera cuts and wide stage angles

signature_moments.what: rapid foot tapping and sliding combined with arm gestures while maintaining a low center of gravity
dropping to the floor in a crouch while spinning on hands and feet
high knee kick with sharp arm motion followed by a quick pivot turn
